def test_payment_authorization_limits():
    order_id = random_string()

    # Valid payment (amount <= 100)
    payment_payload = {
        "address": {"city": "City", "country": "Country", "number": "1", "postcode": "123", "street": "Street"},
        "amount": 50.0,
        "card": {"ccv": "123", "expires": "12/25", "longNum": "1234567890123456"},
        "customer": {"firstName": "John", "lastName": "Doe"},
        "orderId": order_id
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["authorised"] is True

    # Verify payment recorded
    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auths = resp.json()
    assert len(auths) == 1
    assert auths[0]["authorised"] is True
    assert auths[0]["orderId"] == order_id

    # Invalid payment (amount > 100)
    payment_payload["amount"] = 150.0
    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["authorised"] is False

    # Verify second payment recorded
    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auths = resp.json()
    assert len(auths) == 2
    assert auths[1]["authorised"] is False
    assert auths[1]["orderId"] == order_id

def test_end_to_end_order_creation():
    username = random_string()
    password = random_string()

    # 1. Register User
    user_payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify user creation
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["username"] == username
    assert resp.json()["firstName"] == "Test"

    # 2. Add Address
    address_payload = {
        "city": "London",
        "country": "UK",
        "number": "10",
        "postcode": "SW1A 1AA",
        "street": "Downing Street",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=address_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_id = resp.json()["id"]

    # Verify address
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{address_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["city"] == "London"

    # 3. Add Card
    card_payload = {
        "ccv": "123",
        "expires": "12/25",
        "longNum": "1234567890123456",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json()["id"]

    # Verify card
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/cards/{card_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["expires"] == "12/25"

    # 4. Get Catalogue Item
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) > 0
    item_id = items[0]["id"]

    # 5. Add Item to Cart
    cart_item = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 2,
        "unitPrice": 15.5
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=cart_item, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify cart
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cart_items = resp.json()
    assert len(cart_items) == 1
    assert cart_items[0]["itemId"] == item_id
    assert cart_items[0]["quantity"] == 2

    # 6. Place Order
    order_payload = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": f"/addresses/{address_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    order = resp.json()
    order_id = order["id"]

    # Verify order
    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    fetched_order = resp.json()
    assert fetched_order["id"] == order_id
    assert fetched_order["customer"]["username"] == username
    assert fetched_order["address"]["city"] == "London"
    assert fetched_order["total"] > 0

def test_cart_item_management():
    username = random_string()

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    item_id = resp.json()[0]["id"]

    # Add item
    cart_item = {"itemId": item_id, "quantity": 1, "unitPrice": 15.5}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=cart_item, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify add
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["quantity"] == 1

    # Update item
    cart_item["quantity"] = 5
    resp = requests.patch(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=cart_item, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify update
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["quantity"] == 5

    # Delete item
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify deletion
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_cart_merge():
    customer_id = random_string()
    session_id = random_string()

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    item_id = resp.json()[0]["id"]

    # Add item to session cart
    requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{session_id}/items"), json={"itemId": item_id, "quantity": 2, "unitPrice": 10.0}, timeout=10)

    # Merge session cart into customer cart
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/merge?sessionId={session_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify customer cart has the item
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) > 0
    assert items[0]["itemId"] == item_id
    assert items[0]["quantity"] == 2

    # Merge non-existent session cart
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/merge?sessionId=nonexistent_session"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
